input.rationale: § 16.1 does give express M&I warranties that are not time-limited and therefore exceed both duration floors: § 16.1(B) warrants that reports conform substantially to the User Manuals/customer bulletins (documentation conformance), and § 16.1(A) warrants that M&I's systems are capable of performing the Services in accordance with the Agreement, backed by the § 9 Performance Standards. The disclaimer in § 16.1(F) is expressly carved back ("EXCEPT AS SPECIFICALLY SET FORTH IN THIS SECTION 16.1"), so this is not an AS-IS walk-away. The gap is remedial: nowhere does the Agreement give a warranty remedy of repair, replacement or refund. § 12.3 offers only dispute resolution or termination plus Damages, § 13.4 caps that recovery at three months' fees, and the § 9.2(D) service level credits are redacted. That fails two of the four fallback elements on a material term, so we insert a single short remedy subsection at the fallback level. Preferred extras (professional and workmanlike standard, compliance with laws, no malicious code) are noted but not pressed, and § 9.1's "no other or higher degree of care" language is a rationale note only.

proposal.summary: Add repair/replace or refund remedy for breach of the § 16.1 M&I warranties
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The § 16.1 warranties run for the whole Term, which clears our duration floors, but they carry no warranty remedy. We add a short remedy subsection giving repair or replacement of the non-conforming Services or reports, or a refund of the fees paid for them, consistent with our fallback position.

ops.text: Warranty Remedy. For breach of the warranties set forth in this Section 16.1, M&I shall promptly repair or replace the non-conforming Services or reports or, at Customer's election, refund the fees paid for the non-conforming Services or reports.
